netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lin n1 VSS
NMOS M1 n2 VDD n1 VSS
R RL VDD n2
L Lsrc n1 n3
L Lout n2 VOUT1
C Cout n2 VOUT1
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints by adding a source inductor to enhance input matching and boost gain, which directly addresses the poor S21 and excessive NF observed in the prior design. The inductor resonates with the input capacitance to form a series-tuned matching network, improving impedance transformation at 5.8 GHz and increasing transconductance utilization. This reduces noise figure and increases forward gain without increasing Idd, as the inductor is passive and the bias point remains efficient.
